$comment: Written by npm run schemas from core/schema. Change the definition there, not this file.
title: Cursor's hook input
description: The fields of Cursor's hook input (cursor.com/docs/agent/hooks) that XenoNet's Cursor hook keeps, one line per sessionStart, afterFileEdit, stop and sessionEnd, in the file it's told to write. The version is Cursor's own (cursor_version).

conversation_id.description: The conversation, stable across its turns

session_id.description: sessionStart and sessionEnd: the same as conversation_id

file_path.description: afterFileEdit: the file, an absolute path

reason.description: sessionEnd: completed, aborted, error, window_close or user_close
